answer: Make every identity earn its footing slowly, like water carving karst: a new agent must wander through a probation of small, verified jobs before it can hold stake or vote, and its record accrues like a glacier — slow, visible, and hard to fake in bulk. A thousand fresh sock puppets each face the same long thaw, so an attacker's cost scales with every alias while one honest agent pays the wait once and keeps its standing.
